issues_detected.description: No confidentiality classification, HIPAA-compliance status or governance committee contact; only storage/NIH GDS obligations are listed.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add confidentiality_level, hipaa_compliant status and a data_governance.committee_contact for the Data Access Committee.

issues_detected.description: No variable-level metadata (variables), tabular flag or subset flags, although participants.tsv and OMOP-mapped CSV tables are distributed.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add a variables block (identifiers, descriptions, units) for participants.tsv and the OMOP-mapped tables, plus is_tabular and subset flags.

issues_detected.description: at_risk_populations absent: no statement on protections for potentially vulnerable participants (older adults to age 85, cognitive screening).
issues_detected.recommendation: Populate at_risk_populations describing any protections for older or cognitively impaired participants, or state that none were enrolled.

issues_detected.description: No software that produced or transformed the released data (DICOM conversion, OMOP mapping, CDS packaging) is named; REDCap, MoCA Duo and the OMOP DQD serve capture or validation roles.
issues_detected.recommendation: Name the software used for DICOM conversion, OMOP mapping and CDS packaging in used_software, with versions or repositories.

issues_detected.description: No imputation protocol or explicit statement that imputation was not used, despite documented modality-level missingness.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add imputation_protocols, or state explicitly that no imputation was performed.

issues_detected.description: De-identification method 'no identifiers were collected / NoDeIdentification' coexists with removal of sex, race/ethnicity and medication and with a Safe Harbor statement from another source; the record discloses the conflict in source_caveats.
issues_detected.recommendation: Reconcile or explain the de-identification method across sources and list identifiers_removed.

issues_detected.description: License text grants research, commercial and non-commercial use while FAIRhub consent metadata restricts the public version to type 2 diabetes research; both recorded.
issues_detected.recommendation: State which use scope governs the public release (T2D-only vs general research) in license_and_use_terms.

issues_detected.description: No recommended citation text; only the DOI supports citation.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add a recommended citation string in citation.

semantic_insights: Identifiers validate: DOI 10.60775/fairhub.3 matches FAIRhub publisher/page; NIH awards OT2OD032644, P30DK035816, UL1TR003096 follow activity-IC-serial patterns; ORCIDs and ROR IDs well-formed.
Counts are internally consistent: splits 1576+352+352 = 2280 = instances.counts; version increments 204+863 = 1067 and 1067+1213 = 2280.
Temporal order is coherent: IRB approval Dec 20 2022 precedes collection (July 2023 - May 2025) and release (Nov 17 2025).
Human-subjects flag true is matched by IRB approval and informed consent documentation.
Weakest areas: variable-level metadata, named processing software, imputation, vulnerable-population protections and governance contact.
